title: Why do all my tests show up twice in the test explorer?
summary: Tests show up twice in the VS Code test explorer when the pre-release AL Language extension, which now finds tests itself, is installed alongside AL Test Runner. The author suggests going back to the release AL Language version for now. He suspects a bug: test runs hang against containers older than BC28, which leaves Copilot waiting for results.
key_points: The pre-release AL Language extension adds its own AL Tests tree to the test explorer, which duplicates the AL Test Runner entries
With BC28 the AL Language extension can connect to the server to run tests; earlier versions lack this execution support
An All Tests run against a pre-BC28 container never finishes, so an AI model running tests waits forever; the author filed a GitHub issue
AL Test Runner still offers extra features such as code coverage, downloading performance profiles and running page scripts
The author will keep maintaining AL Test Runner until Microsoft's tooling is rich enough to replace it
